findings.title: Countries that share a dialing code resolve to whichever comes first in the list, overriding the user's region.
findings.body:
Several countries share a dialing code: +1 (US/CA and others), +7 (RU/KZ), +44 (GB/JE/GG/IM). `findCountryByPhonePrefix` sorts by prefix length only, so among equal matches it returns the first one in the `countries` list. In `PhoneField`, that inferred country beats `fallbackCountry`.

Example: a Canadian-region user returns to Basic Info with a prefilled `+1…` number. The field then shows the US flag, and the selector opens with US marked as selected, even though their region (and their earlier pick) was CA. An explicit pick is also lost on every remount, because only the number is kept and the country is inferred again.

Fix: pass the fallback country into the helper. When it matches the number's prefix, return it first; otherwise do the longest-match search.
